svg.title: Speech-to-Text Pipeline
svg.desc: An MCP call queues a job and identifies its input audio. JobWorker and the audio source feed TranscriptionService, which decodes and optionally denoises audio, transcribes with Whisper, restores timestamps and stages transcript files. The worker publishes the files and returns a job result.

g.text: Select a model, language and transcription options.
Submit an audio path or a directory for batch jobs.
Validate allowed paths, file sizes and model options.
Create one queued child job per batch file.
Commit the queued job in PostgreSQL.
Shared path keeps the audio on a common filesystem.
Ingest uploads the input before the job is committed.
S3 ingest lets the worker run on a separate host.
Claim the job and dispatch to TranscriptionService.
Open the shared path or fetch the uploaded file.
Save the files to local storage or S3.
Record the results and mark the job complete.
Job ID, status and transcript files
Get a text preview, language and duration.
Receive it inline or call get_job(job_id).

svg.text: The batch parent publishes a manifest. Publish retries can reuse staged transcripts.
Transcribe one file or a batch and publish text, JSON and subtitles.
